name: Calgary
growth_year_note: Homes built in or after 2021, the year of the last published Census (counted 11 May 2021). The 2026 Census population counts are scheduled for 10 February 2027.

playground.label: Playground
playground.threshold_basis: Platform choice: 400 m (about a five-minute walk) and 800 m (about ten minutes), common neighbourhood planning distances.
limitations: City-maintained play structures only; school, developer and condominium playgrounds that are not in the City's inventory are not counted.

park.label: Public park
park.threshold_basis: Platform choice: distance to the park's edge, 400 m and 800 m.
limitations: Every City park site of any size counts, including small sub-neighbourhood parks and linear parks along pathways.
Parks in new communities may still be held by the developer and missing from the City's inventory.

transit_stop.label: Transit stop
transit_stop.threshold_basis: Calgary Transit Service Guidelines (May 2025) measure local coverage as residents within 400 metres of transit service.
limitations: A stop is not a service level: how often buses come is not measured here (planned: the GTFS timetable).

community_centre.label: Community centre
limitations: Community association halls and centres as listed by the City; opening hours and programs are not measured.

rec_centre.label: Indoor recreation centre
rec_centre.threshold_basis: Platform choice: 2 km and 5 km for facilities that serve several communities.
limitations: Leisure centres, aquatic and fitness centres and fieldhouses, municipal and not-for-profit. Arenas, outdoor pools, golf courses and other single-purpose sites are left out. Capacity and opening hours are not measured.

library.label: Public library
limitations: Library branches as listed by the City; hours and size are not measured.

playground|city.threshold_basis: Platform choice: 400 m (about a five-minute walk) and 800 m (about ten minutes), common neighbourhood planning distances.
limitations: City-maintained play structures only; school, developer and condominium playgrounds that are not in the City's inventory are not counted.

homes.unit: one assessed residential property (a house, a townhouse or a condominium unit)

reference.label: Homes lived in (Calgary Data Desk)
reference.note: Calgary Data Desk counts a home as lived in one year after it is built; Canada Insight counts every home on the current property roll, including homes built this year and last. Both use the same roll and rental units.

value_kinds.units: official (one per roll record) except rental buildings, whose units are from building permits (official) or estimated from assessed value (estimate)
value_kinds.status: calculated (a stated rule, not a score)

city_actual.label: City's total, shared by actual growth
city_actual.about: All of Calgary adds up to the City's own population estimate and forecast; each community is its 2021 Census count plus the growth its new homes explain, with the rest of the City's growth spread over every community's 2021 count. Calgary Data Desk's default.

city_pace.label: City's total, one rate for all
city_pace.about: All of Calgary adds up to the City's own estimate; communities built since 2021 keep their growth model count, every other community grows by one factor from its 2021 count.

model.label: Growth model
model.about: 2021 Census for each community, grown with the homes built since on the City's property roll. Children: 2021 Census children plus children for residents added since, at the share seen in communities new at the 2021 Census.

census2021.label: 2021 Census
census2021.about: Each community's 2021 Census count, unchanged. Communities built since 2021 have no count, so they carry no residents or children and get no crowding figure.

park.unit: park hectares per 1,000 residents within reach

transit_stop.unit: transit stops per 1,000 residents within reach

community_centre.unit: community centres per 100,000 residents within reach

rec_centre.unit: indoor recreation centres per 100,000 residents within reach

park|city.unit: park hectares per 1,000 residents within reach

park|private.unit: park hectares per 1,000 residents within reach
